normalization.coordinates: per-axis affine map using train global min/max to unit cube

GINO.features: global per-physical-channel z-score over all train samples and all train points; zero-variance channels use scale 1
GINO.target: single global channel-wise mean/std over all train samples and points
GINO.upstream_difference: CarCFD range-normalizes SDF and triangle area, and UnitGaussianNormalizer.from_dataset(dim=[1]) is tied to its released pressure-array layout; P1i instead has eleven heterogeneous physical channels and no guaranteed cross-sample node-index identity
GINO.reason: point-order invariant, adds no information, and was selected before any formal accuracy

Transolver.features: global per-physical-channel train-only UnitTransformer z-score over samples and points
Transolver.target: single global train-only UnitTransformer z-score over samples and points; decode before metrics

radius.derivation: geometry-only rounded above train/valid input-GNO nearest-source p99; no labels, loss or accuracy
radius.freeze_gate: repeat on all 768 train plus 128 valid_iid coords and run GPU graph-memory preflight before formal seed0

architecture.embedding: official preprocess MLP over coordinates plus pointwise functions

Transolver.loss: upstream TestLoss(size_average=false) relative L2 on decoded output
Transolver.metric_output: decode deltaT_K then emit every Level-A sufficient statistic and named metric from configs/heat3d_v7/v7_metric_contract.json; upstream relative-L2 remains a separate diagnostic
Transolver.checkpoint_reload: save model optimizer scheduler epoch normalizers config upstream SHA and RNG metadata; reload must reproduce frozen valid prediction within deterministic device policy
Transolver.information_contract: coords plus 11 physical features only; no prior, solver, dense field or learned adapter

remote_resource_manifest.first_action: single-seed one-batch forward/backward graph-memory and epoch-walltime preflight
remote_resource_manifest.formal_action: three independent seeds only after resource gate and explicit authorization

checkpoint_selection_policy.sensitivity: also retain and evaluate the upstream final-epoch checkpoint

blockers: no data file manifest or hashes

Therm-FM.input: N,P,L,H,W to N,L_times_P,H,W layer-major flattened grid channels
Therm-FM.normalization: released normalization_constants.json per flattened input channel and output layer; model config and weights are inseparable contract
Therm-FM.pretraining: pretrained Poseidon prior plus Therm-FM fine-tuning
Therm-FM.fairness: pretrained prior != same from-scratch training budget

remaining_remote_preconditions: GINO full-role coordinate-only radius audit and GPU graph-memory preflight
materialize complete train-only normalization statistics without opening forbidden roles
write formal GINO and Transolver launch manifests with immutable data/config/upstream hashes
obtain explicit remote authorization after G1 finishes
resolve DeepOHeat-v1 license/data/checkpoint/dependency provenance before any native formal run
